new_theorems.statement: For two original-coordinate hubs h,s with A_hh=A_ss=A_hs=0, let u=A[K,h], v=A[K,s] on the full complementary bank K and Delta=||u||^2||v||^2-<u,v>^2. If Delta>0, with arbitrary symmetric A_KK and arbitrary affine terms, every independent cap-one product law satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity<=2sqrt(2)Delta^(-1/4) and P{Q in L}<=2sqrt(2)Delta^(-1/4)|L|.
new_theorems.mechanism: Condition on the entire complementary original-coordinate bank; conditional linear anti-concentration in two untouched independent source hubs gives 1/[2max(|U|,|V|)]. The joint coefficient pair (U,V) has density cap 2/sqrt(Delta); layer cake integrates the reciprocal maximum.
new_theorems.continuity: proved by dominated convergence from conditional convolution continuity
